orthogonality_note: Each hypothesis changes decision STRUCTURE, sample definition, or exit/capacity policy — not a re-tune of V3 soft-utility feature families.

hypotheses.orthogonal_to: V3 soft utility blend of risk+opportunity
hypotheses.mechanism: Hard gate: refuse trade if predicted future-unsellable or liquidity-collapse exceeds frozen thresholds; only survivors are ranked by opportunity head. Risk is a veto, not a soft penalty.
hypotheses.failure_condition: OOF wallet PnL<=0 after haircut, or fatal rate not below universe, or does not beat C1/C2/C3

hypotheses.orthogonal_to: V3 training on mixed PROXY_PATH + unaudited rows
hypotheses.mechanism: Restrict modeling and selection to rows with PIT-audited buy SUCCESS and current sell SUCCESS at decision block; drop proxy labels. Tests whether execution-clean sub-universe carries edge.
hypotheses.failure_condition: Clean subsample too thin for repeatable right-tail, or OOF utility still non-positive vs baselines

hypotheses.orthogonal_to: V3 pooled model across lifecycle buckets
hypotheses.mechanism: Fit separate dual-head models inside each formal age bucket; no cross-bucket parameter sharing. Edge may be bucket-local.
hypotheses.failure_condition: No bucket produces positive haircut PnL that beats baselines with repeatable right-tail

hypotheses.orthogonal_to: V3 entry-score focus with fixed 6h horizon wallet label
hypotheses.mechanism: Select on high p(TP-before-SL) and short predicted time_to_right_tail; prefer quick right-tail capture over terminal 6h return.
hypotheses.failure_condition: Short-barrier score does not yield positive OOF wallet PnL with breadth

hypotheses.orthogonal_to: V3 top-k=2 dense selection without deployer weekly cap
hypotheses.mechanism: Ultra-sparse policy: select only utility >= train q90, at most 1 per decision_time, and at most 1 fill per deployer per calendar week to force breadth.
hypotheses.failure_condition: Sparsity removes all edge or remaining winners are lottery-dependent

hypotheses.orthogonal_to: V3 treating 15-60m only as unused negative control
hypotheses.mechanism: Train a fatal/avoid classifier on 15-60m negative-control rows only; apply as PIT veto on formal buckets (transfer of avoid signature, not of V3 alpha scores).
hypotheses.failure_condition: Avoid transfer does not reduce fatal rate enough for positive haircut PnL
